title: bot.ability.processing.output
description: A deliberative tier's answer to one turn: handled with its selections, handed on with what it acted, or failed [floppy fields; mosfet.py's Processing output].

turn.description: The body's processing turn this event belongs to, counted from 1 [floppy field].

handled.description: Whether the tier handled the turn.

target.description: The session id of the event's offerer.

selected.description: A handled turn's selections, each sent to its target.

target.description: The session id of the event's offerer.

acted.description: What a turn handed on had sent.

reason.description: handoff when the turn is handed on; the failure when it failed.

bytes_per_token.description: The fewest request bytes a token any reply showed so far.
